Table "Customers" {
  "CustomerID" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "FirstName" TEXT [not null]
  "MiddleInitial" TEXT
  "LastName" TEXT [not null]
}

Table "Employees" {
  "EmployeeID" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "FirstName" TEXT [not null]
  "MiddleInitial" TEXT
  "LastName" TEXT [not null]
}

Table "Products" {
  "ProductID" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "Name" TEXT [not null]
  "Price" REAL
}

Table "Sales" {
  "SalesID" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "SalesPersonID" INTEGER [not null]
  "CustomerID" INTEGER [not null]
  "ProductID" INTEGER [not null]
  "Quantity" INTEGER [not null]
}



Ref: "Sales"."ProductID" > "Products"."ProductID"

Ref: "Sales"."CustomerID" > "Customers"."CustomerID"

Ref: "Sales"."SalesPersonID" > "Employees"."EmployeeID"
